http/http1_framing#

How long an HTTP/1.1 body is (RFC 9112 §6): none, Content-Length, chunked, until the connection closes, or a tunnel or upgrade after the head.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let plan = Http1ResponseFraming(head: head, method: Method.get).plan();
plan::Plan::kind;                    // Http1BodyKind.chunked
plan::Plan::reuse_after_eof;         // the connection can carry another message

Description#

How long an HTTP/1.1 body is (RFC 9112 §6): none, Content-Length, chunked, until the connection closes, or a tunnel or upgrade after the head.

Only chunked is understood as a transfer coding; any other is UnsupportedTransferCoding. Conflicting lengths are InvalidHttpMessage.
